name: Sun-Dried Tomato Veggie "Meatballs" with Garlicky Kale & Ricotta

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Coat two large baking dishes with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Finely grate Parmesan. Place in a medium bowl along with ricotta, salt, and pepper; stir to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
85 g Parmesan cheese
1 ½ (425 g) pkgs ricotta cheese
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a large bowl. (Reserve the other half for serving.)

Roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the parsley along with half of the cheese mixture, veggie ground, bread crumbs, water, and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine. (Reserve remaining cheese mixture for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
12 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed
680 g veggie ground, plant based
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
3 tbsp water
¾ tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a tablespoon measure, form the veggie ground mixture into rounded "meatballs" and divide between the baking dishes.
Place baking dishes in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until meatballs are browned and nearly cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and place in a clean large bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and thinly slice garlic. Add to the bowl with the kale.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and kale to the pot in handfuls, waiting for kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring frequently, until the kale is tender, 2-3 minutes more. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Add vinegar, crushed red pepper, and salt to the pot with the kale; stir to combine. Remove from heat and cover with a lid to keep warm.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place tomato sauce, Italian seasoning, and additional crushed red pepper in the reserved bowl. Stir to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the meatballs are lightly browned, remove from oven. Pour tomato sauce over meatballs, return to oven, and continue to bake until the sauce is warm and meatballs are cooked through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide meatballs, sauce, kale, and reserved cheese mixture between plates or bowls. Top with reserved parsley and enjoy!
